test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"contempt."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Contempt"** means feeling or showing disrespect or hatred towards someone or something. (यह भावना कि कोई व्यक्ति सम्मान का हक़दार नहीं है तथा उसका कोई महत्व नहीं है; तिरस्‍कार, अवज्ञा) • **Example:** *He showed **contempt**__ towards his colleagues.* • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: When he was in college, a famous poet made a useful distinction for him. He had drunk __enough__ in the poet's company to be compelled to describe to him a poem he was __thinking__ of. It would be a monologue of sorts, the self-contemplation of a student on a summer afternoon who is reading Euphuise. The poem itself would be a subtle __series__ of euphuisms, translating the heat, the day, the student's concerns, into symmetrical posies; translating even his __**contempt**__ and boredom with that famously foolish book into a euphuism. The poet nodded his big head in a sympathetic, rhythmic way as this was ______ (5) ______ to him, then told him that there are two kinds of poems. There is the kind you write; there is the kind you talk about in bars. Both kinds have value and both are poems; but it's fatal to confuse them. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Weightage** means the amount of importance or value given to something. (किसी चीज़ को दिया गया महत्व या मूल्य) • **Haven** means a safe place or refuge. (मनुष्‍यों या पशुओं के लिए सुरक्षित विश्रामस्‍थल) • **Stay** means to remain in a particular place or condition. (किसी स्‍थान पर ठहरे रहना (वहाँ से चले न जाना)) 157:T103d, The correct answer is **"explained."**
